name: Csharp Lsp Roslyn
description: C# language server for code intelligence
longDescription: An LSP integration for C#: `plugin.json` declares a `roslyn` server started as `dotnet dnx -y --prerelease roslyn-language-server -- --stdio --autoLoadProjects`, mapping `.cs` to `csharp`, so Claude Code gets Roslyn's diagnostics and code intelligence. Requires the .NET SDK 10.0 or later; `dnx` fetches the language server on first start. The repository carries only `plugin.json` and a README, and no license file.

license.note: No license text found upstream (searched the item directory and the repository root).
